changes.title: Islands
items: You now play a small island of 10 areas round home (add ?island=20, 30, 40 or 50 to the link for bigger ones, or ?island=off for the old big map)
Every island starts gentle: the animals get stronger wave by wave on one curve, whatever the island's size
One relic bottle for every 10 areas, now mirrored and in new colours, and never the same bottle in the same colour twice on an island

changes.title: Rule tweaks
items: After landing you can't rise to the treetops again for 3 seconds: dodge instead
A blink goes the way you're moving (or facing, standing still), not where you aim
Animals that bring down a soundsystem march inward, never out to one further from home
The Player picker (human or bot) only shows with the debug overlay on

changes.title: Party ends home
items: The party's over as soon as your home speakers are all destroyed, even if other soundsystems are still standing
When the party ends, any soundsystems still standing switch off: their music, lasers and lights go out
